# Element, UIElement, FrameworkElement, Control markup reference

Extensions every element or control accepts: layout, alignment, visibility, input events, attached-property helpers, and control appearance.

### Element

Receiver: `Element` and derived types (`where T : Element`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `CanvasBottom(double bottom)` |  | Sets the canvas bottom position. |
| `CanvasLeft(double left)` |  | Sets the canvas left position. |
| `CanvasPosition(double left, double top)` |  | Sets the canvas position. |
| `CanvasRight(double right)` |  | Sets the canvas right position. |
| `CanvasTop(double top)` |  | Sets the canvas top position. |
| `Column(int column)` |  | Sets the grid column. |
| `ColumnSpan(int columnSpan)` |  | Sets the grid column span. |
| `DockBottom()` |  | Docks the element to the bottom. |
| `DockLeft()` |  | Docks the element to the left. |
| `DockRight()` |  | Docks the element to the right. |
| `DockTo(Dock dock)` |  | Sets the dock position. |
| `DockTop()` |  | Docks the element to the top. |
| `GridPosition(int row, int column)` |  | Sets the grid position. |
| `GridPosition(int row, int column, int rowSpan, int columnSpan)` |  | Sets the grid position with spans. |
| `Row(int row)` |  | Sets the grid row. |
| `RowSpan(int rowSpan)` |  | Sets the grid row span. |

### UIElement

Receiver: `UIElement` and derived types (`where T : UIElement`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AllowDrop(bool value = true)` | `AllowDrop` | Sets whether the element accepts drops, taking part in drop-target hit testing and receiving DragEnter, DragOver, DragLeave and Drop. |
| `BindIsEnabled(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, bool> convert)` | `bind IsEnabled` | Binds the enabled state to a converted observable value. |
| `BindIsEnabled(ObservableValue<bool> source)` | `bind IsEnabled` | Binds the enabled state to an observable value. |
| `BindIsVisible(ObservableValue<TSource> source, Func<TSource, bool> convert)` | `bind IsVisible` | Binds the visibility state to a converted observable value. |
| `BindIsVisible(ObservableValue<bool> source)` | `bind IsVisible` | Binds the visibility state to an observable value. |
| `CacheMode(CacheMode value)` | `CacheMode` | Sets how this element's rendering is cached, or null for no cache. |
| `Cached(bool cached = true)` |  | Enables (or disables) bitmap caching of the element's rendered output. The cached bitmap is blitted each frame until the element's content, size, or DPI changes; the visual tree stays live. Equivalent to assigning a BitmapCache to CacheMode. |
| `CanDrag(bool value = true)` | `CanDrag` | Sets whether the element initiates drag sessions via a mouse gesture. |
| `Cursor(CursorType cursor)` | `Cursor` | Sets the cursor type. |
| `Cursor(CursorType? value)` | `Cursor` | Sets the cursor shown while the mouse is over this element; null inherits from the parent or the platform default, and None hides the cursor. |
| `Disable()` | `IsEnabled = false` | Sets IsEnabled to false. |
| `Enable()` | `IsEnabled = true` | Sets IsEnabled to true. |
| `Focusable(bool value = true)` | `Focusable` | Sets whether this element can receive keyboard focus. |
| `IsEnabled(bool value = true)` | `IsEnabled` | Sets whether the element is enabled for input. |
| `IsHitTestVisible(bool value = true)` | `IsHitTestVisible` | Sets whether the element participates in hit testing. |
| `IsTabStop(bool value = true)` | `IsTabStop` | Sets whether the element participates in Tab traversal. |
| `IsVisible(bool value = true)` | `IsVisible` | Sets whether the element is visible. |
| `OnDragCompleted(Action<DragCompletedEventArgs> handler)` | `event DragCompleted` | Subscribes handler to DragCompleted. Occurs once a drag session originating from this element has ended (drop, reject, or cancel). |
| `OnDragEnter(Action<DragEventArgs> handler)` | `event DragEnter` | Subscribes handler to DragEnter. Occurs when a drag enters the element's hit-test bounds. |
| `OnDragLeave(Action<DragEventArgs> handler)` | `event DragLeave` | Subscribes handler to DragLeave. Occurs when a drag leaves the element's hit-test bounds. |
| `OnDragOver(Action<DragEventArgs> handler)` | `event DragOver` | Subscribes handler to DragOver. Occurs while a drag is over the element. |
| `OnDragStarting(Action<DragStartingEventArgs> handler)` | `event DragStarting` | Subscribes handler to DragStarting. Occurs after a drag gesture is detected on this element; handlers populate Data and AllowedEffects to start the session, or set Cancel. |
| `OnDrop(Action<DragEventArgs> handler)` | `event Drop` | Subscribes handler to Drop. Occurs when data is dropped onto the element. |
| `OnGotFocus(Action handler)` | `event GotFocus` | Subscribes handler to GotFocus. Occurs when the element receives keyboard focus. |
| `OnKeyDown(Action<KeyEventArgs> handler)` | `event KeyDown` | Subscribes handler to KeyDown. Occurs when a key is pressed while the element has focus; marking it handled also drops the text input the keystroke would produce. |
| `OnKeyUp(Action<KeyEventArgs> handler)` | `event KeyUp` | Subscribes handler to KeyUp. Occurs when a key is released while the element has focus. |
| `OnLostFocus(Action handler)` | `event LostFocus` | Subscribes handler to LostFocus. Occurs when the element loses keyboard focus. |
| `OnMouseDoubleClick(Action<MouseEventArgs> handler)` | `event MouseDoubleClick` | Subscribes handler to MouseDoubleClick. Occurs when the user double-clicks a mouse button over the element. |
| `OnMouseDown(Action<MouseEventArgs> handler)` | `event MouseDown` | Subscribes handler to MouseDown. Occurs when a mouse button is pressed over the element. |
| `OnMouseEnter(Action handler)` | `event MouseEnter` | Subscribes handler to MouseEnter. Occurs when the mouse enters the element. |
| `OnMouseLeave(Action handler)` | `event MouseLeave` | Subscribes handler to MouseLeave. Occurs when the mouse leaves the element. |
| `OnMouseMove(Action<MouseEventArgs> handler)` | `event MouseMove` | Subscribes handler to MouseMove. Occurs when the mouse moves over the element. |
| `OnMouseUp(Action<MouseEventArgs> handler)` | `event MouseUp` | Subscribes handler to MouseUp. Occurs when a mouse button is released over the element. |
| `OnMouseWheel(Action<MouseWheelEventArgs> handler)` | `event MouseWheel` | Subscribes handler to MouseWheel. Occurs when the mouse wheel is scrolled over the element. |
| `Opacity(double value)` | `Opacity` | Sets the opacity of the element and its subtree, from 0 to 1. |
| `Register(TemplateContext ctx, string name)` |  | Registers an element by name in a template context. |
| `SkipViewportCull(bool value = true)` | `SkipViewportCull` | Sets whether the element is drawn even when it lies outside the viewport; inherited by descendants. |
| `TabIndex(double value)` | `TabIndex` | Sets the position in the Tab order. |

### FrameworkElement

Receiver: `FrameworkElement` and derived types (`where T : FrameworkElement`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Bottom()` | `VerticalAlignment = Bottom` | Aligns the element to the bottom. |
| `Center()` | `HorizontalAlignment = Center`, `VerticalAlignment = Center` | Centers the element horizontally and vertically. |
| `CenterHorizontal()` | `HorizontalAlignment = Center` | Centers the element horizontally. |
| `CenterVertical()` | `VerticalAlignment = Center` | Centers the element vertically. |
| `ContextMenu(ContextMenu value)` | `ContextMenu` | Sets the menu shown when the pointer is right-pressed over this element. |
| `Height(double value)` | `Height` | Sets the explicit height; NaN means automatic sizing. |
| `HorizontalAlignment(HorizontalAlignment value)` | `HorizontalAlignment` | Sets the horizontal alignment within the parent. |
| `Left()` | `HorizontalAlignment = Left` | Aligns the element to the left. |
| `Margin(Thickness value)` | `Margin` | Sets the outer margin. |
| `Margin(double horizontal, double vertical)` |  | Sets the margin with horizontal and vertical values. |
| `Margin(double left, double top, double right, double bottom)` |  | Sets the margin with individual values. |
| `Margin(double uniform)` | `Margin` | Sets the margin uniformly. |
| `MaxHeight(double value)` | `MaxHeight` | Sets the maximum height in DIPs; the default is no bound. |
| `MaxWidth(double value)` | `MaxWidth` | Sets the maximum width in DIPs; the default is no bound. |
| `MinHeight(double value)` | `MinHeight` | Sets the minimum height in DIPs. |
| `MinWidth(double value)` | `MinWidth` | Sets the minimum width in DIPs. |
| `OnLayoutSizeChanged(Action<SizeChangedEventArgs> handler)` | `event SizeChanged` | Adds a size change handler. |
| `Right()` | `HorizontalAlignment = Right` | Aligns the element to the right. |
| `Size(double size)` |  | Sets the size uniformly. |
| `Size(double width, double height)` | `Width`, `Height` | Sets the size. |
| `StretchHorizontal()` | `HorizontalAlignment = Stretch` | Stretches the element horizontally. |
| `StretchVertical()` | `VerticalAlignment = Stretch` | Stretches the element vertically. |
| `StyleSheet(StyleSheet value)` | `StyleSheet` | Sets a StyleSheet that provides named styles and type-based style rules for descendant controls. |
| `Tag(object value)` | `Tag` | Sets an arbitrary object value for custom use. |
| `ToolTip(Element value)` | `ToolTip` | Sets what to show when the pointer rests on this element. |
| `ToolTip(string text)` | `ToolTip` | Sets the tooltip text. |
| `Top()` | `VerticalAlignment = Top` | Aligns the element to the top. |
| `VerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment value)` | `VerticalAlignment` | Sets the vertical alignment within the parent. |
| `Width(double value)` | `Width` | Sets the explicit width; NaN means automatic sizing. |
| `WithTheme(Action<Theme, T> apply, bool invokeImmediately = true)` |  | Registers a theme callback. |

### TextElement

Receiver: `TextElement` and derived types (`where T : TextElement`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `FontFamily(string value)` | `FontFamily` | Sets the font family; an empty value follows the theme's font family. |
| `FontSize(double value)` | `FontSize` | Sets the font size. |
| `FontStyle(FontStyle value)` | `FontStyle` | Sets the font style, which selects the family's italic face. |
| `FontWeight(FontWeight value)` | `FontWeight` | Sets the font weight. |
| `Foreground(Color value)` | `Foreground` | Sets the foreground (text) color. |

### Track

Receiver: `Track`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `DecreaseElement(Element value)` | `DecreaseElement` | Sets the element filling the region between the minimum end and the thumb. |
| `IncreaseElement(Element value)` | `IncreaseElement` | Sets the element filling the region between the thumb and the maximum end. |
| `IsDirectionReversed(bool value = true)` | `IsDirectionReversed` | Sets whether the minimum sits at the far end, as it does on a vertical slider. |
| `Maximum(double value)` | `Maximum` | Sets the maximum value. |
| `Minimum(double value)` | `Minimum` | Sets the minimum value. |
| `Orientation(Orientation value)` | `Orientation` | Sets the axis the thumb travels along. |
| `Thumb(Thumb value)` | `Thumb` | Sets the thumb element. |
| `ThumbLength(double value)` | `ThumbLength` | Sets the thumb's length along the axis; NaN takes the thumb element's desired length. |
| `Value(double value)` | `Value` | Sets the value the thumb is placed for. |
| `ViewportSize(double value)` | `ViewportSize` | Sets the viewport size in value units, which sizes the thumb like a scroll bar; NaN keeps the thumb at ThumbLength, as a slider does. |

### Control

Receiver: `Control` and derived types (`where T : Control`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Background(Color value)` | `Background` | Sets the background color. |
| `Bold()` | `FontWeight = Bold` | Sets the font weight to bold. |
| `BorderBrush(Color value)` | `BorderBrush` | Sets the border color. |
| `BorderThickness(double value)` | `BorderThickness` | Sets the border thickness. |
| `CornerRadius(double value)` | `CornerRadius` | Sets the corner radius for background/border rendering. |
| `FontSize(ThemeFontSize size)` | `FontSize` | Sets the font size resolved once from the current theme's ThemeMetrics; themes with per-variant metrics re-resolve by calling this inside a WithTheme callback. |
| `Italic(bool italic = true)` |  | Sets the font style to italic, or back to upright. |
| `Padding(Thickness value)` | `Padding` | Sets the inner padding. |
| `Padding(double horizontal, double vertical)` |  | Sets the padding with horizontal and vertical values. |
| `Padding(double left, double top, double right, double bottom)` |  | Sets the padding with individual values. |
| `Padding(double uniform)` | `Padding` | Sets the padding uniformly. |
| `SemiBold()` | `FontWeight = SemiBold` | Sets the font weight to semi-bold. |
| `StyleName(string value)` | `StyleName` | Sets the named style key, resolved from the nearest StyleSheet up the tree and taking priority over StyleSheet type rules and the theme style. |
| `Template(ControlTemplate value)` | `Template` | Sets the template that provides this control's visual tree; null keeps the control's own drawn visuals. |

Receiver: `SyntaxViewer`.

### Thumb

Receiver: `Thumb`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `OnDragDelta(Action<Vector> handler)` | `event DragDelta` | Subscribes handler to DragDelta. Occurs on each pointer move during a drag, with the total distance from the press point. |
| `OnDragEnded(Action<bool> handler)` | `event DragEnded` | Subscribes handler to DragEnded. Occurs when the drag ends; true when the capture was taken away instead of released. |
| `OnDragStarted(Action handler)` | `event DragStarted` | Subscribes handler to DragStarted. Occurs when a press takes the mouse capture and a drag begins. |

### CommandSourceControl

Receiver: `CommandSourceControl` and derived types (`where T : CommandSourceControl`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Command(Command value)` | `Command` | Sets the semantic command this control invokes. |
| `CommandData(object value)` | `CommandData` | Sets CommandData. The value this control hands its command as the invocation argument. Null lets the nearest ICommandArgumentSource above the control supply the argument instead. |
| `CommandToolTipMode(CommandToolTipMode value)` | `CommandToolTipMode` | Sets CommandToolTipMode. Which parts of the command this control builds a tooltip from when it has no ToolTip of its own. Defaults to none: a control that shows its command's text and icon has already said what a tooltip would say. |
